title: Contractual decoder chaos & graceful fallback harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a deterministic test harness that stresses the constrained decoder and JSON-enforcement layers with injected token-level perturbations and simulated partial streams. Verify graceful fallback scoring when strict schema adherence fails and ensure tool/function calls remain correct under degraded decoding. This ticket covers the harness design, a matrix of experiments, automated regression jobs, and integration with cost/latency dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end harness can run 500 parametric scenarios in CI within 40 minutes
When structured output is enabled, enforcement pass rate >= 98% for baseline models on core prompt set
Fallback policy triggers correctly (model-variant or schema-relaxation) and is recorded in telemetry with reason codes
Tool-calling sequences are validated post-fallback and any mismatches produce actionable diagnostics
Regression job runs nightly and files a GitHub issue automatically if pass rate drops by >3% vs baseline
test_plan: Create a baseline prompt corpus that covers: nested objects, arrays with mixed items, optional fields, enum drift, and tool-call embeddings
Implement a token-perturbation engine that injects: extra commas, truncated arrays, unexpected unicode, repeated keys, and streaming truncation mid-object
Run constrained-decoder with three enforcement modes: strict-JSON-mode, relaxed-schema-mode, and permissive-with-repair
Measure pass/fail, number of repair attempts, latency delta, and tokens generated per scenario
Validate tool-call correctness by executing mocked tool handlers and asserting call signature + payload semantics after any repair/fallback
experiments_matrix: Stream conditions: full response, partial-stream (truncate 10-50%), interleaved noise tokens
Token bias settings: none, light-bias towards schema tokens, heavy-bias
Batch sizes: 1, 8, 32 (to identify batching-induced race conditions)
monitoring_queries: schema_enforcement.rate: percentage of responses that pass primary schema check
fallback.invocations: count by reason_code per hour
toolcall.mismatch_rate: fraction of tool calls whose post-processed payload differs from expected schema
decoder.retries: histogram of repair attempts per response
rollout_plan: Run harness in experimental CI lane for two weeks against canary seeds
Enable nightly regression and create baseline snapshots after 2 successful runs
Gate runtime rollout on no new critical failures for 3 consecutive nightly runs
Expose a limited pilot to internal integrators with telemetry surfacing fallback reasons
remediation_playbook: If enforcement pass rate drops >5%: capture failing traces, run targeted diagnostic job, and rollback strict mode to relaxed for affected model-variant
If toolcall.mismatch_rate >1%: halt rollout and trigger on-call decoder engineer; collect full token trace and payload diff
Page SRE if fallback.invocations spikes >200% sustained over 15 minutes

notes: Trade-offs: strict enforcement improves schema purity but increases token cost for repair; permissive mode reduces failures but increases downstream ambiguity
We will store token-level traces for at most 90 days to limit storage costs; longer retention possible for flagged customer incidents
Consider future work to auto-generate minimal repair patches using a constrained-synthesis approach
